question: Do those fully established in knowledge deliberate at death?
premises: Some knowers are formed by well-practiced realization.
They are always Śiva-natured and liberated while living.
Deliberation belongs to incomplete or unstable states.
inference: Therefore those liberated while living have no deliberation at all at the time of death.
plain_english: But those whose being is formed by well-practiced knowledge, who are always of the nature of Śiva and liberated while living, have no deliberation whatsoever at death.
